Bug_Details: Class is a JUnit TestCase but has not implemented any test methods.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by creating a class that extends TestCase from the JUnit framework without implementing any test methods. This violates the rule IJU_NO_TESTS.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method on an instance of ExampleBug. Since ExampleBug does not contain any test methods, the presence of this test case highlights the absence of test methods in the original class, thus triggering the bug.
